reply.thought: The first step is to get a list of all orders to know which customers need payouts. I will use the list_orders tool for this.

Now that I have the list of orders, I need to determine the net balance for each unique customer. I will use the net_balance tool for each customer identified from the orders: 'acme', 'birch', and 'cobalt'. I will call net_balance for all unique customers in one go if the tool allows, otherwise, I will call it sequentially. I see three unique customers.
Next, I need to get the net balance for the 'birch' customer.
Finally, I need to get the net balance for the 'cobalt' customer.

I have successfully retrieved the net balances for all customers: acme (31368 cents), birch (19998 cents), and cobalt (24286 cents). Now I must record a payout for each customer using the record_payout tool. I will perform these actions sequentially.
The payout for 'acme' was successful. Now I will record the payout for 'birch'.
The payout for 'birch' was successful. Finally, I will record the payout for 'cobalt'.
All required payouts have been recorded successfully. I will now generate the final report.
